WHY: Real provider URL/resource will differ from mock
ACTION: Replace runtime base URL/resource path after validation; do not hard-code secrets.

WHY: Production auth scheme is unknown
ACTION: Configure supported headers/tokens; extend HttpAdapter only if the confirmed scheme is unsupported.

WHY: Mock schema is not production truth
ACTION: Update contract and source-to-canonical mapping.

WHY: Production version not yet known
ACTION: Register authoritative version and rerun contract/regression tests.

WHY: Current demo keys may not match production semantics
ACTION: Obtain business-owner confirmation before Silver/Gold acceptance.

WHY: Mutable/snapshot/incremental/late-arrival behavior is unknown
ACTION: Confirm update/delete/late-arrival rules; then validate stale protection and MERGE behavior.

WHY: Current platform proves cursor-style mock pagination
ACTION: Reuse existing cursor path if compatible; otherwise add only a controlled transport extension.

WHY: No specialized 429/Retry-After/backoff policy is implemented
ACTION: Implement provider-approved retry/backoff only after SLA evidence.

WHY: Storage path is source-native and generic
ACTION: Keep current Bronze writer if the source can be normalized to supported ingestion envelope.

WHY: Generic lineage metadata is independent of business schema
ACTION: Preserve existing metadata/checksum behavior.

WHY: Real contract values must replace mock assumptions
ACTION: Update endpoint/schema/mapping/key/routing metadata without creating a second configuration source.

WHY: Mechanics are generic and proven across two datasets
ACTION: Do not rewrite unless a genuine unsupported requirement is demonstrated.

WHY: Real mapping/DQ semantics may differ
ACTION: Update mapping and business-rule configuration with signoff.

WHY: Metric semantics depend on authoritative source meaning
ACTION: Revalidate formulas/grain/lineage; change only when evidence requires it.

WHY: Storage/versioning mechanics are source-independent
ACTION: Retain architecture; review production governance separately.

WHY: Serving layer reads canonical Gold tables
ACTION: Retain unless production access/security requirements require configuration changes.

WHY: BI layer reads Gold through Trino
ACTION: Adjust labels/filters only if canonical/business fields change.

WHY: Generic 8-stage orchestration routes through Registry
ACTION: Reuse same DAG; only transport/config changes should vary unless a confirmed requirement proves otherwise.

WHY: Current local/demo inline sensitive settings are not production-ready
ACTION: Externalize secrets, rotate where appropriate, harden auth/CSP/access controls before production.

WHY: Current logs/states/lineage exist but centralized SLI/SLO/alerting is incomplete
ACTION: Define alerting, retention, ownership and SLOs without changing business processing semantics.
